evals.prompt: 去 X 上找几条关于 AI agent 的中文热帖，挑一条你觉得值得回的，写一条回复。别发，先给我看。
evals.expected_output: Uses search hot with lang:zh and min-likes, reads the section with comment section, drafts a reply, runs comment check, does not post.

evals.prompt: 我昨天在 X 上给一条推发了回复，回来的时候说 delivery_uncertain。现在怎么办？
evals.expected_output: Does not resend. Checks auth status, reads the conversation, checks the receipt, reports what was found.

evals.prompt: 帮我看下我 X 上收藏了哪些东西，把其中跟 agent 有关的挑出来，顺便我看看有没有能取消的。
evals.expected_output: Uses saved bookmarks, filters for agent-related posts, does not auto-unbookmark.

evals.prompt: 现在 X 上什么最火？给我看看热榜，然后挑两个话题找点帖子。
evals.expected_output: Uses trend read (topics, not posts), then search keyword with those topics. Does not confuse the two.
